name: The St. Regis Hotel Washington D.C.
positioning: Historic Beaux-Arts St. Regis hotel (officially The St. Regis Washington, D.C.) two blocks from the White House
best_for: Travelers who want a historic hotel close to the White House
Guests who value butler service, especially in suites
Business and legal travelers who need dedicated office space

facts.text: The hotel is located two blocks from the White House.
The hotel is a member of Historic Hotels of America.
The hotel has hosted presidents including FDR and Truman.
Guest rooms have Pratesi linens and Remède Spa bath products.
All suites come with St. Regis Butler Service.
A personal butler is available around the clock.
Alhambra serves shareable plates drawing on flavors of the Iberian Peninsula and the Middle East.
Alhambra is open for breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner.
Afternoon Tea is served in the hotel's lobby lounge and changes with the season.
The St. Regis Bar serves seasonal cocktails, a global wine list and small bites.

highlights.text: The hotel holds a nightly Champagne Sabering ritual in the grand lobby.
The restaurant Alhambra is named after the Alhambra palace and fortress in southern Spain.
The grand lobby has ornate Florentine gold ceilings and crystal chandeliers.
The Presidential Suite was decorated by the interior design firm Myron Wolman Designs, and it connects with a Superior Room so it can be configured as a two-bedroom suite.
The Capital Mary is the hotel's take on the Bloody Mary, inspired by the Chesapeake Bay region.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle; Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport is about 5 miles away.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
Pets up to 25 pounds are welcome for a non-refundable fee.
